content:
maria: FYI the Go quickstart generator sample hangs when cancelling the context during the initial handshake. tiny repro attached — reproducible on macOS and Linux. :confused:

sam: sdk version? go version? can you paste the minimal repro?

maria: go 1.20, go-sdk v0.13.2. minimal snippet below. the call to gen.Close() blocks until the outer ctx times out, and pprof shows leaked goroutines:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
defer cancel()

g := client.Generator("gpt-open", opts...)
for g.Next(ctx) {
  tok := g.Value()
  fmt.Println(tok.Text)
}
// expecting immediate return after cancel but it stalls here
g.Close()
```

pprof excerpt: 
```
net/http: request canceled
goroutine 142 [select]:
  net/http.(*persistConn).roundTrip(...)
```

leo: sounds like the handshake goroutine spawned by Generator() uses a background ctx and isn't cancelled by the ctx passed to Next, so Close blocks waiting for the handshake to finish.

jen: are you using the iterator API intentionally? there's also the callback form where the user provides a handler that might thread cancellation differently.

maria: iterator is what the quickstart shows and what users expect as a simple example. this mismatch is surprising for newcomers.

sam: quick workaround: cancel the ctx used for Next() then call Close() in a goroutine with its own timeout. ugly but works until we fix the SDK.

ci-bot: created issue DE-2345: "go-sdk: generator handshake ignores cancellation in iterator flow" — https://tracker/internal/DE-2345 :white_check_mark:

leo: API proposal: accept an initial ctx at construction time so callers can tie the handshake lifecycle to their request lifecycle, e.g. NewGenerator(ctx, ...). also change Close() -> Close(ctx) to allow bounded waits. smaller change: add WithHandshakeCtx(ctx) functional option.

jen: i can patch the quickstart to document the cancel pattern and show both iterator and handler patterns. also add a note in onboarding about always passing a ctx to constructors when possible.

maria: uploaded a failing test gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/handshake-repro which runs `go test -run TestHandshakeCancel` and reproduces the leak.

sam: sounds like we need eng-runtime/engine to ensure handshake goroutine respects ctx and devex to update docs. @leo can you draft a small PR?

leo: will open a draft PR that adds WithHandshakeCtx and a Close(ctx) variant, plus unit tests that ensure Close doesn't hang when handshake ctx is cancelled. will also add a note in generator.go explaining the rationale.

jen: once PR lands i'll update quickstart sampleapp and the onboarding README. also add a small migration blurb for folks on v0.13.x. :+1:

maria: thanks all — marking this as high-onboard-friction in the issue. really appreciate the quick triage! :raised_hands:
